export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/transasia-bio-medicals-limited) shows an actual outbound shipment row: "2026-02-27 | TRANSASIA BIO-MEDICALS LIMITED | AO ERBA RUS | Laura XL system Fully automated urine analyzer, Sr.Nos.:0753-X2-210824 ... | BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | SHEREMETYEVO, RUSSIA | 90278990 | BOL 1091271". Additional export lanes visible in the same table: destination Phuntsholing, Bhutan (buyer KMT PHARMACEUTICAL AND MEDICAL SUPPLIES, 384 shipments) and LCS Jaigaon port lane (113 records). Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 7399 Records detected", "Trading Partners 94", "Ports 97"; rows actually rendered in the free view = 5 dated shipment rows (4 of them inbound imports to Transasia, 1 outbound export to Russia). So 7399 is the platform's aggregate counter, not rows seen — only 1 export row was directly observed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/international split could be retrieved: company site https://www.transasia.co.in/ returned HTTP 302 redirect loop, /about-us returned 404, and registry aggregators (thecompanycheck, zaubacorp) returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply is therefore not evidenced by any record I could open. Note that the customs data does show India-side port activity (SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC 312, SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4 145, BANGALORE ACC INBLR4) but these are import/export lanes, not domestic sales.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data under the exact name TRANSASIA BIO-MEDICALS LIMITED, address TRANSASIA HOUSE, 8, CHANDIVALI STUDIO ROAD (Mumbai-registered address, though claimed state is Punjab — the Punjab link is the historical incorporation; not verified from a registry because zaubacorp/thecompanycheck were 403). Export factuality: CONFIRMED by a dated customs record with destination Russia, HS 90278990 and BOL 1091271 — this is a real shipment, not a website claim. The company is primarily an importer/manufacturer of IVD reagents and analysers (inbound rows from Erba Lachema Czech Republic, Actif Corporation Japan, Chema Diagnostica Italy, Shenzhen Dymind, Medica Corporation, Fapon International), so it is a manufacturer_trader profile, not a pure trader. HS check: declared codes 382219/382290/850440/902780 are consistent with observed trade codes 38221990, 38229090/90279090 and 90278990 — no HS correction needed; 850440 was not observed in the visible rows but is plausible for analyser power supplies and is not contradicted. Domestic supply: no GST turnover band, tender or contract record obtained — status declared_only, not confirmed; I did not find a domestic-supply record I could open, so I am not asserting domestic deliveries. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts only (7399 aggregate, direction not split), no value data, and no annual report was accessible. No CIN/PAN verified from a registry; PAN AAACT2038C is unverified (registry access blocked), not confirmed or refuted.
